stories.title: Coalition of the Willing has no exit strategy for Ukrainian conflict — European MP
stories.summary: "Europe is becoming more and more willing to arm itself instead of engaging in diplomatic efforts," Danilo Della Valle added
article_sentences: The Coalition of the Willing has no exit strategy for the Ukrainian conflict and is doing its best to spill it into EU territory, reads a statement by the European Parliament faction of Italy’s opposition.
Five Star Movement, signed by its member Danilo Della Valle.
"The truth is that the so-called willing have no political strategy for exiting this conflict and are doing their best to bring the conflict directly to EU soil," the statement reads.
"Europe is becoming more and more willing to arm itself instead of engaging in diplomatic efforts," the European Parliament member added.
A number of members of the coalition of the willing convened in Kiev for a meeting to coincide with the 35th anniversary of Ukraine’s independence.

stories.title: Bank of Russia raises dollar rate to 83.29 rubles for August 25
stories.summary: The official euro exchange rate was raised by 57.83 kopecks to 97.4384 rubles
article_sentences: The Bank of Russia set the official dollar exchange rate for August 25, 2026 at 83.2878 rubles, up 36.67 kopecks from the previous rate.
At the same time, the official euro exchange rate was raised by 57.83 kopecks to 97.4384 rubles.
The official yuan exchange rate rose by 5.1 kopecks to 12.3853 rubles.
